Jonathan Constable

By: Harri Vithi | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
From Visa to Empty Bank Account: A career conman with a free pass.

Unique Selling Point:
Scamming
Career criminal
Masquerading as a pilot (TBC)
Milking desperate refugees
Hijacking buildings
Police receiving bribes


Summary:
Jonathan Constable is a career criminal accused of scamming refugees using the false promise of resettlement - for a fee.

Further information:
Background
The United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees defines resettlement as and i quote:-
One of the three durable solutions. Resettlement to a third country involves the selection and movement of a refugee from his/her country of asylum (South Africa) to another country that has agreed to admit him/her as a refugee and to permanently settle there.

Resettlement is a limited solution available to refugees who meet very specific requirements. The criteria are defined by the Resettlement Country, specific protection needs and particular vulnerabilities. UNHCR monitors individual cases of refugees on an ongoing basis and determines those eligible for Resettlement Consideration.

Resettlement Identification is done regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, marital status, education, level, social status, nationality or religion. Yet, in order to be identified for Resettlement, you need to meet the Resettlement criteria.

No refugee is automatically entitled to be considered for Resettlement after living a certain number of years in their country of asylum.Refugees do not apply for resettlement. Cases are identified through the information gathered by UNHCR through a variety of channels.

The above is key because Jonathan Constable's - JC Administrative Services - alleged, it provided resettlement services to refugees yet, only the UNHCR can identify and facilitate the process of resettlement. The politics of migration is complex and since 2015 when, people fleeing well-documented conflict and human rights abuses were left to drown in the Mediterranean Sea - access to refugee-hosting countries has grown increasingly restrictive.

The reality is, refugees cannot self-identify as candidates for resettlement and pay for facilitation thereof.
It's set out in black and white on the UNHCR website but it is said people do not read. It is this failure to research the publicly available terms and conditions of resettlement which led to the refugees parting ways with, what is believed to be hundreds of thousands of Rands.
The promise: a one way ticket to the lands of milk and honey - Canada and the good ole US of A.

The Story
A key ingredient of any scam is desperation - it wears the guard down.
Jonathan Constable - has seemingly observed this human trait, often, in his unique line of work.
Constable is allegedly a national conman - Mpumalanga, Durban, Limpopo, Cape Town - provincial lines are no hindrance.
And they shouldn't be, after all Constable is a self-professed airman, apparently jetsetting across the globe - even lending his aviator hands to relief efforts in the Ukraine.

But, there's a different form of relief sought by those, who say, they are victims of Constable's unending gutter schemes.
The so-called pilot's dirty dance with foreign nationals began in the mid-2000s or thereabouts and unfortunately Constable, is yet to develop guilty feet.
Since 2019, refugees from Burundi and the Democratic Republic of Congo began protesting outside the offices of the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) - they've sporadically been at it ever since.

With flare ups of xenophobic attacks, the refugees demand the South African government and UNHCR relocate them to other countries.
"Unrealistic" was the feedback received by the refugees.
No, quite realistic - according to Jonathan Constable - who is said to have played ambulance chaser at the protests, scouting for prospective "clients". God's faithful Congolese servants were also targeted at churches, cross-country.
And boy did he rope them in! Before, we delve into Constable's latest alleged shenanigans - let's take a trip down memory lane to 2013 when, Constable allegedly scammed the widow of a murder victim.

Meisie - The Widow (Snag, location- Musina)
Her name is Meisie and she says she never wants to see Constable again because he milked the death of her husband. He roped in alleged police officers who "assisted" by insisting she pay their water and light bills, petrol, loan them her vehicle and pay their tollgate fees. All so they could investigate! Constable intimated he had Meisie's husband's murder docket in his NGO office safe and to secure it, she'd need to cough up some cash - and she did. Neisie says she knows other who were scammed of credit cards and cars.
Thando - The Security (2018)
Constable roped him in under the guise he was running some clean up operation of Rosettenville buildings - he needed help with evictions. Thando says he executed the evictions because court orders were produced when police were called, so he believed the court orders were legit. Turns out Constable was the hijacker and Thando never received a red cent for his 3-month eviction services. It didn't end there- Thando discovered Jonathan had allegedly scammed at least five other people- a real estate company owner of over R 100 000 and a group of Congolese with itchy feet, of thousands of Rands. Thando says he'll introduce us to Constable's other scamees and try to set him up for a confrontation.
*Comfortable with on-camera interview and claims he knows others who are willing
Pastor Femi - Run Away Man of God (2014)
He ran a church and introduced a number of his flock to Constable, claiming he was going to get them to the land of milk and honey or its northern neighbor. Pastor Femi says he too paid Constable thousands of Rands convinced Africa would see his backside. But why would a grown man traipse about South Africa with a random man for zero financial gain? This is what the pastor's conned congregants and neighbours wondered when Constable disappeared, poof into thin air. They went after the Pastor who is allegedly on the run.
*Claims to be afraid of Constable and refuses to partake in an interview. Apparently he's escaped to Swaziland in the last week. Voice Recording available
Nomsa - The Whistleblower
Nomsa is a Zimbabwean national residing jn South Africa, who applied for relocation with UNHCR in 2014. She's still awaiting feedback so it made sense when she heard of Constable's- JC Administrative Services - relocation services, her hope was renewed but short-lived. She says when she joined the relocation group and payment to UNHCR was referenced - the hairs on the back of her neck stood up. Nomsa says she immediately began to query the payments and Constable admonished her. Peeved, Constable allegedly sent the man of God to level some threats about her children's safety if she should choose to keep talking. Yes, a pastor and a hitman of sorts. She's in hiding in Durban because due says Constable has a gun and is friends with cops. Nomsa reported what she believes is a scam to UNHCR - she says the organization did nothing.

Monica - South Africa First Movement
Monica runs an immigration desk and Nomsa was referred to her via Facebook. Nomsa reported the entire sordid mess to Monica who conducted some preliminary investigations into Constable before passing hhe information to the authorities who seemingly are yet to act on it. Monica then reached out to me.
*Open to on-camera interview
Wazi - The Airline Agent
Wazi says she met Constable through Pastor Femi and thought he was legit. He often operated his pseudo immigration services from her home in Germiston. She alleges she paid R 15 000 for relocation services as it's price per head. But like all the others- playing in the snow seems a distant dream. Given her work at the airport, Wazi is well-versed with airline and pilot protocols. Wazi says Jonathan said pilot on the box but there is no pilot in the box. She began to question his tall flight tales and he began to distance himself, she says. In addition, she advised pilots uniform can be purchased anywhere and doesn't require proof of a license - she believes Jonathsn purchased the uniform at a now burnt down store called " Brothers" on the East Rand. Chances are he posed in planes at the airport museum because the planes in his social media pics are so outdated - definitely not in use. After he slithered into hiding she says his victims threatened her as they concluded she was a beneficiary of the scam.
* Voice Recording- not willing to to partake in interview but we can film silhouette with these types, alter voice and leave out any identifying facts
I've spoken to at least 8 people so far who say they were scammed by Jonathan.
My primary concern is ensuring he can be physically located.

Script:


JONATHAN CONSTABLE
SCRIPT FOR VIEWING 2

UPSOUND

VO 1: This is Jonathan Constable.
As a self-proclaimed saviour of South Africa - Constable fights corruption, assists with labour law issues, facilitates conveyancing and corporate transactions… and so much more.

VO 2: And on top of all that…he’s a pilot! … or at least so he claims…


UPSOUND LINK DEREK WATTS FX3_8024/25/26/27 D
Insert Derek / pilot links FX3_8024/25/26/27 Comes out in pilot’s outfit FX3:8028/9

Fake police, fake soldiers, fake doctors – In a world of fakes, it’s hard to tell what’s real anymore…

UPSOUND LINK DEREK WATTS FX3:8028/9 Derek Watts Voila, so now I’m dressed like a pilot… but you wouldn’t want me at the controls of any aircraft…

VO 3: Constable's Facebook page states he received his pilots training at Priority Air Transport.

VIZ: Google search
VO 4: A Google search, most closely links the name "Priority Air Transport" to a battalion of the United States Army…

VO 5: Which must be why Constable posted this badge on Facebook.

VO 6: But, which country Constable served - as a pilot and/or a soldier is unclear.
After all, 52-year old Constable is South African.

UPSOUND MONICA BOW, INDEPENDENT INVESTIGATOR
Monica Bow, Independent Investigator
20:23 I can't see how can you fly a plane if you're not a pilot…

VO 7: If Constable is the villain in this piece, then Monica Bow is the hero. As an independent investigator, she has been on his trail for years.

20:23 Monica Bow, Independent Investigator
I've asked at the airport please find this guy's license - it's not there but yet he's got the uniform for it…

VO 8: It is here at the South African Airways Museum Society in Germiston – in this 1971 Boeing – where we suspect Constable took these blurry images…

Derek walking in airplane aisle
It all seems like fun and games but the reality is Constable has been arrested 19 times for various crimes since the 1980s

VO 9: And if Constable’s flights of fancy were limited to only being an airman, it would be mildly amusing…
But it's here that our story takes a sinister turn

UPSOUND MONICA BOW, INDEPENDENT INVESTIGATOR
TC FX6_0877@08:10 Monica Bow, Independent Investigator

…Today he’s a pilot, tomorrow he's a home affairs official, then he's with special training forces with the cops, then he's a CI, he's been everywhere else even in Iraq fighting.


VO 10: Constable is also the self-professed President of his organization NICSA…

Depending on the day NICSA is - a political party, a trade union, an NGO, an immigration agency or an undercover operation.


UPSOUND MONICA BOW, INDEPENDENT INVESTIGATOR
He’s got quite a portfolio.. And also something to do with housing… That is why they say he is one of the best hijackers of a hijacked building in South Africa…


VO 11: In 2017, Constable - through NICSA - approached Nomusa Ninela and her fellow tenants AT A HOUSE THEY WERE RENTING IN ROSETTENVILLE, JOHANNESBURG …offering to protect them from what he called fake landlords who were charging exorbitant rentals.

UPSOUND NOMSA NINELA
He said we cannot pay the rent to someone who doesn’t have ownership of the house…

VO 12: All Nomusa had to do was pay his NICSA membership fees.

UPSOUND NOMSA NINELA
FX6_0897
….you’ll be paying him a registration – R1500 – and every month we would be paying R500 for our membership…

VO 13: Effectively, Constable was encouraging tenants to withhold THEIR rent from their landlords.

VO 14: Greg Vermaak is a property lawyer, who has previously crossed legal swords with Constable .

UPSOUND GREG VERMAAK, PROPERTY LAWYER
FX6_0881 01:07 03:05 Greg Vermaak, Property Lawyer
Constable will come into a building and he will say, these guys who you are paying rent to don't own the building. There's some fraud, there's some take over.They are in fact “the hijacker”. So do not pay them. What you must do is join my organization and I will look after you, protect you…that’s the classic hijack play

VO 15: Business was booming for Constable and in 2021, Nomusa says he approached her again.

VO 16: But this time he convinced her to leave her job and join NICSA as an administrator.

VO 17: And he also contracted this man: Luthando Makazula. He owned a security company which Constable supposedly wanted to use to evict people he couldn't extort for NICSA membership fees.

UPSOUND DEREK WATTS
FX3_7992 00:10 Derek Watts
Thando, so this whole complex was hijacked?

UPSOUND THANDO MAKAZULA
FX3_7992 00:17 Luthando Makazula, Former Service Provider
It’s big hey all these blocks here, that side as well - jahh he hijacked all these blocks

VO 18: At the time Luthando says he believed Constable’s dealings were above board.

FX3_7992 08:27 Derek
What were your feelings about the families being evicted?

UPSOUND THANDO MAKAZULA
FX3_7992
I had to do the job that they employed me for - to do the evictions but sometimes I feel pity for them… because you can see them, they are crying… you can see them there crying, others don't have money to pay rentals… they were having a lot of problems

UPSOUND LOUIS BIRKENSTOCK, TUPA REAL ESTATE
0:55 Louis Birkenstock
Poverty is a big problem. And especially the areas we operate in it's the lower end of the market.
VO 19: Louis Birkenstock manages and administers residential properties in Johannesburg South. In March 2021, trouble started.

UPSOUND LOUIS BIRKENSTOCK
FX6_0875 04:09 Louis Birkenstock, Tupa Real Estate
The whole building stopped paying immediately in one month. Sometimes you do get problems with you'd have one or two problems that you attend today. Try and settle with a tenant to try and come to some arrangement. But it's a whole building all of us and just stopped and they used to be good payers. Something must be wrong.

VO 20: Constable allegedly hijacked at least four buildings managed by Louis’ company and when Louis eventually evicted non-paying tenants, Constable became infuriated showing up at Louis’ offices with a gun.



UPSOUND LOUIS BIRKENSTOCK
Luckily, immediately she turned and ran to the back. We were all sitting in the back office hiding away there.

VO 21: There is an outstanding warrant of arrest for Constable, and he is on the police’s wanted list of suspects.

UPSOUND LUTHANDO MAKAZULA
FX3_7990
The funny thing is the guy is driving around here and the police know the guy.

FX3_799010:08 Luthando Makazula
… even if you try to arrest the guy he’s untouchable

VO 22: Luthando told us he was never paid by Constable for his security services.

UPSOUND LUTHANDO MAKAZULA
FX3_7985 6:03 Luthando Makazula
He owes me 85000 …

VO 23: Nomusa also says she NEVER GOT her PROMISED salary… and when she reminded Constable he owed her…it cost her dearly.

UPSOUND NOMSA NINELA
TC…he threatened us … I will come after you I know where you're staying I know your kids

VO 24: And Nomusa says he made good on his threat; shockingly Constable weaponised his police contacts to arrest and torture her.

TC
…He hit me, he pushed me, he put some handcuffs like this my hands they were
bleeding

VO 25: And if that humiliation wasn’t enough, it got worse when she was flung into Johannesburg Prison – known as Sun City.

UPSOUND NOMSA NINELA, FORMER EMPLOYEE
FX6_0880
… it was not easy asking myself what did I do? SunCity is cold I’ve never experienced Sun City in my life - for 7 days for seven days without brushing your teeth without doing anything without using a toiletries, without using a soap to bath. 7 days for something that I didn’t do… Jonathan and his crew, they need to pay - they need to pay big time

VO 26: Nomusa says she was charged with drug possession. But she didn’t have any drugs on her and believes Constable was behind her arrest.


FX6_0880 16:48 Derek Watts
When did you last HEAR FROM Jonthan Constable?

UPSOUND NOMSA NINELA, Alleged Scam Victim
FX6_0880 16:48
…the time he was calling me he wanted to help me to destroy my case he said I must raise
10,000

VO 27: Constable sent Nomusa a voice note with instructions

GD: Proof of bribe request 0:31
Hi, good morning Nomsa, - be at Germiston Police Station at 09h00 a.m and also make sure you have the R 10 000 with you.

VO 28: Nomusa says she did not take Constable up on his offer ... and her drug possession case is ongoing.

Insert: Rosettenville Link - Derek

VO 29: In addition to allegedly hijacking buildings, not paying contractors and intimidating his detractors - Constable offered to resettle refugees from war-torn countries for a hefty fee.

03:41 Derek
Monica what was he promising?

UPSOUND MONICA BOW
03:43 Monica Bow, Independent Investigator
…New lives with visas that he got from the embassy here in SA - Canadian Embassy.


VO 30 : As a self-proclaimed immigration expert…in a pilot’s uniform, no less… he could get refugees to Canada…something only the United Nations High Commission for Refugees or UNHCR is allowed to do.

04;29 Derek
What was he charging?

0:4:31 Monica Bow, Independent Investigator
For a family R 75000

04:35 Derek
R 75000

04:38 Monica Bow Independent Investigator
R 75000 —some people sold all their belongings because they were leaving and it never materialized.


VO 31:To run the resettlement scam, Constable allegedly created a Whatsapp group where he would keep the refugees updated

Add JC Whatsapp VN

04:12 Monica Bow, Independent Investigator
30 people were on the group 30 people were conned he was using an actual visa from the Canadian Embassy but when I received all the information it was obviously verified as fake.

31. GD JC Pic Canadian Embassy

31. GD JC Fake

VO 32: This is the closest the refugees ever came to Canada…the high commission in Pretoria…with this “visa” that Constable is believed to have doctored.

The Canadian High Commission states it is aware of the allegations and the UNHCR says it's investigating.

UPSOUND MONICA BOW
05:44 Derek
As you investigated what shocked you the most about him

05:52
The fact that he was well connected —- people are so scared of him
and the other thing is that he was so well protected. Whoever I contacted in my network everybody knew about Jonathan.

VO 33: We called Constable for his side to the many stories we’d been told.

UPS DEREK ON THE PHONE
Hello can we speak to Jonathan Constable
….NO IT’S THE WRONG NUMBER

VO 34: Constable ultimately made contact with Carte Blanche and vehemently denies all allegations made by his accusers.

VO 35: We asked the National Prosecuting Authority, and departments of Justice and Home Affairs for comment." - we are still awaiting their response.

UPSOUND MONICA BOW, INDEPENDENT INVESTIGATOR
07:11 Monica Bow, Independent Investigator
I have all the proof. I have forwarded the whole thing onto SS. I've forwarded it onto home affairs, I've forwarded it onto the CI and nothing has been done.

VIZ: New Pic JC at airport museum dated 7th April 2023
VO 36: As Jonathan Constable continues to roam freely his alleged victims wonder where is the justice…








PROMOS

1 – 11”
He's known as “the president”, supposedly protecting the defenseless and fighting for the underdogs…but is he Robin Hood or just a common scammer?





2 – 21”

One man, many scams… from alleged building hijacking to bogus refugee resettlement…

UPSOUND: NOMUSA
That guy is a smart talker… He’s a crook

So why is he not in prison?

UPSOUND: LUTHANDO
He’s got connections with the police, Home Affairs, Sheriff of the Court and High Court as well.

3 – 21”

Dressed in uniform, this man is selling fake dreams and false promises…

UPSOUND MONICA
Today he’s a pilot, tomorrow he's a home affairs official, then he's with special training forces with the cops, then he's a CI, he's been everywhere else even in Iraq fighting.

We follow the trail of an alleged serial scammer.

metadata.Further information: Background The United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees defines resettlement as and i quote:- One of the three durable solutions. Resettlement to a third country involves the selection and movement of a refugee from his/her country of asylum (South Africa) to another country that has agreed to admit him/her as a refugee and to permanently settle there. Resettlement is a limited solution available to refugees who meet very specific requirements. The criteria are defined by the Resettlement Country, specific protection needs and particular vulnerabilities. UNHCR monitors individual cases of refugees on an ongoing basis and determines those eligible for Resettlement Consideration. Resettlement Identification is done regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, marital status, education, level, social status, nationality or religion. Yet, in order to be identified for Resettlement, you need to meet the Resettlement criteria. No refugee is automatically entitled to be considered for Resettlement after living a certain number of years in their country of asylum.Refugees do not apply for resettlement. Cases are identified through the information gathered by UNHCR through a variety of channels. The above is key because Jonathan Constable's - JC Administrative Services - alleged, it provided resettlement services to refugees yet, only the UNHCR can identify and facilitate the process of resettlement. The politics of migration is complex and since 2015 when, people fleeing well-documented conflict and human rights abuses were left to drown in the Mediterranean Sea - access to refugee-hosting countries has grown increasingly restrictive. The reality is, refugees cannot self-identify as candidates for resettlement and pay for facilitation thereof. It's set out in black and white on the UNHCR website but it is said people do not read. It is this failure to research the publicly available terms and conditions of resettlement which led to the refugees parting ways with, what is believed to be hundreds of thousands of Rands. The promise: a one way ticket to the lands of milk and honey - Canada and the good ole US of A. The Story A key ingredient of any scam is desperation - it wears the guard down. Jonathan Constable - has seemingly observed this human trait, often, in his unique line of work. Constable is allegedly a national conman - Mpumalanga, Durban, Limpopo, Cape Town - provincial lines are no hindrance. And they shouldn't be, after all Constable is a self-professed airman, apparently jetsetting across the globe - even lending his aviator hands to relief efforts in the Ukraine. But, there's a different form of relief sought by those, who say, they are victims of Constable's unending gutter schemes. The so-called pilot's dirty dance with foreign nationals began in the mid-2000s or thereabouts and unfortunately Constable, is yet to develop guilty feet. Since 2019, refugees from Burundi and the Democratic Republic of Congo began protesting outside the offices of the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) - they've sporadically been at it ever since. With flare ups of xenophobic attacks, the refugees demand the South African government and UNHCR relocate them to other countries. "Unrealistic" was the feedback received by the refugees. No, quite realistic - according to Jonathan Constable - who is said to have played ambulance chaser at the protests, scouting for prospective "clients". God's faithful Congolese servants were also targeted at churches, cross-country. And boy did he rope them in! He roped in alleged police officers who "assisted" by insisting she pay their water and light bills, petrol, loan them her vehicle and pay their tollgate fees. All so they could investigate! Constable intimated he had Meisie's husband's murder docket in his NGO office safe and to secure it, she'd need to cough up some cash - and she did. Neisie says she knows other who were scammed of credit cards and cars. Thando - The Security (2018) Constable roped him in under the guise he was running some clean up operation of Rosettenville buildings - he needed help with evictions. Thando says he executed the evictions because court orders were produced when police were called, so he believed the court orders were legit. Turns out Constable was the hijacker and Thando never received a red cent for his 3-month eviction services. It didn't end there- Thando discovered Jonathan had allegedly scammed at least five other people- a real estate company owner of over R 100 000 and a group of Congolese with itchy feet, of thousands of Rands.
